forces: Node applications require concrete implementations of Core platform SPIs without violating Core's platform neutrality.
AsyncLocalStorage context propagation must ensure strict isolation across concurrent asynchronous execution chains without cross-scope data leakage.
Shutdown timers must support unref to avoid retaining host processes while strictly avoiding the installation of process signal handlers.
The package must maintain standalone repository topology with zero third-party runtime dependencies and private unlicensed status.
The package public API must remain explicitly provisional and unfrozen until vertical evidence is established under PLAN-047.
